name: scenario_Layers_stack_and_blend_live
description: Several layers render at once and Drivers blends them into one frame. The stack is built one layer at a time on a cleared canvas, blended, reshaped, resized, moved to another layout and taken apart again, all while it renders, and every step is measured so the cost of a layer is the difference between two readings. A pipeline that only ever ran one layer would pass every other scenario, which is why this one stacks three.

steps.name: clear-the-layers
steps.description: Whatever layers the device had go, so the stack is built from nothing and every layer in it is one this scenario placed.

steps.name: clear-the-layouts
steps.description: The same for the layouts, so the grid below is the only one.

steps.name: grid
steps.description: A 32x32 panel: big enough that three layers blending show as three different pictures.

steps.name: base-layer
steps.description: The first layer, which everything later is blended onto.

steps.name: base-effect
steps.description: A plasma, which fills every light from the first frame, so the layers above have something to blend with.

steps.name: measure-one-layer
steps.description: One layer: Drivers hands its buffer over without blending. The floor the stack is read against.

steps.name: second-layer
steps.description: A second layer on top, which turns the hand-over into a blend.

steps.name: second-effect
steps.description: Metaballs, which leave most lights dark, so the plasma shows through where they are not.

steps.name: measure-two-layers
steps.description: Two layers blended: the difference against one layer is what the blend costs.

steps.name: add-light
steps.description: Additive rather than alpha: the top layer's light is added to the plasma instead of covering it.

steps.name: half-strength
steps.description: And at a little over half strength, so the two pictures mix rather than one winning.

steps.name: third-layer
steps.description: A third layer, the depth where an ordering fault in the blend would show.

steps.name: third-effect
steps.description: Fireworks, which move fast and fade, so the third layer is visibly its own.

steps.name: mirror-the-sparks
steps.description: A mirror on this layer alone: a modifier reshapes its own layer and leaves the two below untouched.

steps.name: measure-three-layers
steps.description: Three layers, one of them through a lookup table: the shape of a real installation.

steps.name: swap-the-base
steps.description: The base effect is swapped for a nebula while the two layers above keep rendering on top of it.

steps.name: the-base-holds-the-new-effect
steps.description: A control only a nebula has, read through the slot's own id, which separates a swap from a step that did nothing.

steps.name: measure-swapped-base
steps.description: Three layers again, with the bottom one replaced under a running stack.

steps.name: grow-the-grid-wide
steps.description: The grid grows while all three layers render, and every layer reallocates its buffer to the new size.

steps.name: measure-bigger-grid
steps.description: The same stack over more than twice the lights: the difference is what the size costs.

steps.name: another-shape
steps.description: The grid becomes a wheel of spokes: a different layout under the same three layers, which re-map without being rebuilt.

steps.name: measure-wheel
steps.description: The stack on a wheel, a layout with far fewer lights than the grid it replaced.

steps.name: switch-a-layer-off
steps.description: The middle layer is switched off rather than removed: it stops blending and keeps its place and settings.

steps.name: measure-one-layer-off
steps.description: Two of three layers rendering: an off layer costs nothing.

steps.name: remove-the-top-layer
steps.description: The top layer goes, effect and modifier with it, while the base keeps rendering.

steps.name: the-base-survived
steps.description: The base still answers through its own control, so taking a layer away left the rest of the stack whole.

steps.name: measure-taken-apart
steps.description: Back to one enabled layer: the nebula on the wheel, with Top still in the stack but switched off, after the top layer and its effect and modifier were taken away.
